repairReason.correction: Reference-source correction: an elevated near-frontal three-quarter view with the animal directed generally right, exposing BOTH actual eyes, the real siphon, continuous mantle/head and both natural fin roots where fins exist. Arms extend in gentle noncrossing separated curves with each real root-to-tip path visible; no invented far eye or disconnected arm. Squid and Cuttlefish have eight arms PLUS two longer club-tipped feeding tentacles; Octopus and Giant Octopus have eight arms, no added feeding tentacles or fins. Preserve natural webbing and source-observed anatomy, never alter counts to fit a template.
